title: Event
description: The causal glue between runs. Emitted by kernel, memory, tools, agents, supervisor, HITL. Consumed by subscriptions to trigger new runs or resume in-flight waits. Every event has an ID for idempotent delivery; every subscription is policy-scoped. Delivery is at-least-once with idempotent handlers.

id.description: Unique event ID. Enables dedup on the consumer side (at-least-once delivery).

tenantId.description: Tenant that owns this event. Cross-tenant delivery is denied by policy.

actor.description: Who emitted this event (agent id, tool id, subsystem name, user id).

subject.description: The primary object the event is about.

causedBy.description: Zero or more IDs (event IDs or provenance node IDs) that caused this event. Extends the causal DAG across the reactive boundary — an agent that runs because of an event has provenance edges back through the event to its emitter.

scope.description: Optional additional scoping (project, thread, session). Interpreted by subscriptions.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Consumers must tolerate unknown fields for forward compatibility.

attributes.description: Non-structural annotations useful for filter predicates (e.g. severity, kind hints, feature flags).
